column3: The Hebrew explicitly says “as yesterday and the day before.”
The previous work is described as “yesterday and the day before.”
The Hebrew speaks of work being “heavy on the men” and of “words of falsehood.”
The Hebrew says the foremen “cried out” where BSB has “appealed.”
The Hebrew says “our smell” and repeats “in the eyes of” for Pharaoh and his servants.
The final question is “Why then did You send me?” rather than “Is this why You sent me?”
